mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand, which drives positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are negative when both HOUST and RSAFS rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a rising federal funds rate triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior quarter signals robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative despite INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.5% in the prior quarter, it indicates economic contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are negative when both PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% combined with CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers aggressive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
